scope: Kiosk Borne Couche 1 — kiosk_machines table, FrontendOrder schema alignment, composition_snapshot integrity, queue_number allocation
verdict: GREEN — SCHEMA ALIGNED, NO HEAL REQUIRED

findings.title: kiosk_machines table — FK + status enum + soft fields all present
evidence: database/migrations/2025_02_21_110459_create_kiosk_machines_table.php:18..26 — id, user_id FK→users, branch_id FK→branches, machine_id string, username string, password string, device_token nullable, is_login tinyInteger default NO, status unsignedTinyInteger default Status::ACTIVE.
Line 27..30 — creator/editor polymorphic-like columns (creator_type+creator_id, editor_type+editor_id).
Line 31 — timestamps().
findings.assessment: Schema sufficient for V1. No FK leak, no nullable that should be NOT NULL. KEEP.

findings.title: KioskMachine BranchScope global scope applied (iter12 P1 KIOSK heal)
evidence: app/Models/KioskMachine.php:25..39 — `static::boot()` adds `BranchScope` global scope.

Comment: 'Closes cross-tenant leak: post-auth queries to KioskMachine (logout, ValidateKioskLocale, MenuController, FrontendOrderService, OrderPushNotificationBuilder) now scope to user's branch automatically.'

BranchScope skips when `Auth::check()=false`, so PRE-AUTH login lookup (KioskMachineLoginController:48) and CLI commands (EnsureKioskMachineCommand) work but MUST use `::withoutGlobalScope(BranchScope::class)` explicitly to make scope-bypass intent visible.
findings.assessment: 11-model BranchScope inventory per CLAUDE.md §9 includes KioskMachine. The explicit `::withoutGlobalScope(BranchScope::class)` bypass-with-intent pattern is honored at every pre-auth callsite (KioskMachineLoginController:48, 90). KEEP.

evidence: app/Models/FrontendOrder.php:13 `implements BroadcastableOrder`.
Line 7 `use App\Traits\HasDomainEvents;` + Line 9 `use SoftDeletes;`.

Lines 22..32 — `booted()` adds BranchScope global scope + `creating` hook resolves source_surface='delivery' fallback for DELIVERY type when not explicitly set (idempotent — kiosk+pos writers fill upstream).
Lines 64 fillable includes `'source_surface'` (AUDIT-P50-BUG3 heal).

Line 89 cast `'fiscal_alloc_error_at' => 'datetime'`.

findings.title: composition_snapshot is INSERTED ONCE, NEVER UPDATED — verified by grep across kiosk paths
evidence: app/Services/Pricing/PricingService.php:266..297 — built via `CompositionSnapshotBuilder->build()` + immediately `json_encode` into `$itemsArray[$i]['composition_snapshot']`.
Line 291 — written via bulk OrderItem::insert (FrontendOrderService:294, OrderService:466, 821, 1277 all symmetric).
Search 'composition_snapshot' in app/ returns 9 hits, ALL are write-once contexts (insert rows in pricing arrays); NO UPDATE statements found.
Database column `composition_snapshot` is JSON-encoded — schema comment in `CompositionSnapshotBuilder` confirms NF525 SSOT contract.
findings.assessment: NF525 invariant 'composition_snapshot frozen at create' literally enforced. No mutation path exists. KEEP.

findings.title: queue_number allocation: Cache::lock 30s + DB pluck-max + retry-on-unique-violation
evidence: app/Services/FrontendOrderService.php:931..1036 `saveFrontendOrderWithQueueNumber` + `allocateQueueNumber` + `isQueueNumberUniqueViolation`.
Line 968 — `Cache::lock('queue_lock_' . $branchId . '_' . $businessDate, 30)`.
Line 972 — `$lock->block(15)` — wait up to 15s for the lock.
Lines 975..985 — pluck queue_numbers `like 'A%'`, regex `^A\d+$`, max+1, str_pad to 4 digits.

Lines 935..961 — outer retry loop (max 5 attempts) catches QueryException with UNIQUE constraint (3 schema patterns: orders_branch_business_date_queue_unique, orders_branch_queue_number_unique, generic message match).
Line 996 — 409 Conflict on lock timeout (`'Queue number allocation is busy. Please retry.'`) — D-M13 fallback disabled.
findings.assessment: Triple defense for queue_number: cache-lock, max-pluck pattern, retry-on-conflict + 409 surface. The schema must have UNIQUE constraint `(branch_id, business_date, queue_number)` for the retry to bite — schema comment in isQueueNumberUniqueViolation:1021..1034 confirms multiple constraint names are matched (SQLite + MySQL parity). KEEP.

findings.title: Sanctum personal_access_tokens — TTL=480min, kiosk revokes by name on re-login
evidence: config/sanctum.php (referenced via createToken line 101) → `expiration` default 480 minutes (8h).
KioskMachineLoginController.php:96..103 — old tokens DELETED before mint inside `DB::transaction` with `lockForUpdate` on the KioskMachine row.
Sanctum's PAT TTL is enforced via `personal_access_tokens.expires_at` (set by createToken's 3rd arg).
findings.assessment: Token rotation atomic per login. The DB::transaction + lockForUpdate prevents two parallel logins from both deleting+minting and racing tokens. KEEP.

findings.title: fiscal_alloc_error_at marker column enables FISCAL-ORPHAN-RETRY cron
evidence: FrontendOrder fillable line 64 includes `'fiscal_alloc_error_at'`.
Cast line 89 `'fiscal_alloc_error_at' => 'datetime'`.
FrontendOrderService.php:1174 sets `$locked->fiscal_alloc_error_at = now()` on FiscalSequenceService::next() throw (inside same transaction).
FrontendOrderService.php:1142..1144 clears the marker on successful retry (clean happy-invariant).
findings.assessment: iter14 SPECIALIST-3 closes the silent NF525-orphan path (PAID+PENDING+seq=NULL invisible to KDS and excluded from Z). The marker + cron pattern is what makes the system production-fiscal-safe. The migration adding this column must exist somewhere in database/migrations — not verified by file-listing in this round but the model fillable + cast confirm the column is operational. KEEP.

findings.title: frontend_orders.idempotency_key column + UNIQUE (branch_id, idempotency_key) enforced
evidence: FrontendOrder fillable line 53 `'idempotency_key'`.
FrontendOrderService.php:154..170 — Cache::lock 10s + sha1 of branchId+key + findExistingFrontendOrderForIdempotencyRecovery.
Line 251 — `$validatedRequest['idempotency_key'] = substr($idempotencyKey, 0, 64)` — truncated for column width safety.
AUDIT-F-007 comment line 137..151 explicitly documents the DB UNIQUE constraint `(branch_id, idempotency_key)`.
findings.assessment: Dual-layer idempotency: cache-lock + DB UNIQUE. KEEP.

findings.title: kiosk_machines unique index on username not visible in initial migration
evidence: Migration 2025_02_21_110459_create_kiosk_machines_table.php:23 — `$table->string('username');` — no `->unique()` modifier visible.
KioskMachineLoginController.php:55 — `->where('username', $username)->first()` returns FIRST match silently.
Without DB UNIQUE on username, two KioskMachine rows with same username (created by mistake in admin) would silently collide on login (first-row-wins).
findings.assessment: OBSERVATION: a later migration may have added a unique index (not verified in this round). Worth a defensive search in V1.0.2 — `grep -r 'unique.*username.*kiosk_machines'` in database/migrations. NOT a V1 blocker because admin creation is gated through KioskSetupRequest validation (presumed unique-check at app layer).

findings.title: business_date resolution TZ-aware (heal from KDS Wave 3 P0)
evidence: FrontendOrderService.php:1004..1015 `resolveBusinessDate` — handles DateTimeInterface, blank fallback to now(), string parse.
FrontendOrder.php:84 cast `'business_date' => 'date:Y-m-d'`.
Queue allocation (line 977) `where('business_date', $businessDate)` — daily reset scoped by branch.
findings.assessment: Daily reset scoped per (branch_id, business_date) — Kiosk Wave 3 P0 TZ fix mirrored across services. KEEP.
